title: Carrot Top released from hospital after suicide attempt, rep says
summary: Carrot Top has been released from the hospital following treatment after a suicide attempt last week, a representative for the comedian confirmed to NBC News on Saturday.
story: Carrot Top has been released from the hospital following treatment after a suicide attempt last week, a representative for the comedian confirmed to NBC News on Saturday.
The 61-year-old performer, whose real name is Scott Thompson, was hospitalized after the Sept. 18 attempt. Further details about the medical emergency have not been made public.
“His family and those closest to him are deeply grateful for the concern, prayers and respectfully ask for privacy,” a spokesperson for the comedian said in a statement last week.

The hospitalization comes amid contentious civil litigation involving the comedian. In court filings, Carrot Top’s lawyers have accused singer-entertainer Brian Evans of trying to extort their client — allegedly demanding large payouts while threatening to expose embarrassing information, “false allegations” and “salacious materials.” Evans claims to have appeared as an opening act for Carrot Top’s Las Vegas show.

Following the suicide attempt, Carrot Top’s lawyers asked the judge overseeing the case to limit what Evans, who is representing himself, could file on the public docket, arguing that the release of “intensely private material on a docket monitored by national media” would cause irreparable harm.
Carrot Top rose to fame in the 1990s for his curly red mane and loud wardrobe, and has remained  a pop culture figure for decades.

If you or someone you know is struggling or in emotional distress, call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org 24/7, to reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. For additional resources, visit SpeakingOfSuicide.com/resources.

title: Third suspect arrested in death of Mississippi woman found hanging at ‘staged’ crime scene
summary: A third person has been arrested in the death of Tasia Fortune, a 29-year-old woman who police said was found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned Mississippi home in August.
story: A third person has been arrested in the death of Tasia Fortune, a 29-year-old woman who police said was found hanging from a tree behind an abandoned Mississippi home in August.
Eric Clark, 45, surrendered to police on Friday and is charged with murder. Police also disclosed on Friday that according to an autopsy investigation, “the scene and the hanging were staged.”
No other details were released about the scene or Fortune’s killing.
Clark is expected to appear in court on Monday.
Two other people, Earnest Lloyd Jr. and Jarques Ratliff, were also arrested and charged with murder in connection with her death. Both men are Black.

Police have released very little information about what led up to Fortune’s death. Detectives investigating the case have interviewed as many as 15 people, collected forensic evidence and followed numerous leads, police said in a news release.
Authorities said Ratliff, 51, had an “association” with Fortune but did not release further details.

Lloyd, 25, allegedly had a physical altercation with Fortune either days or minutes before she died, according to NBC affiliate WLBT of Jackson. Police accused Lloyd of hanging Fortune with a black cable cord, WLBT reported.
Ratliff, who pleaded not guilty, and Lloyd were denied bond at separate court hearings.

title: Ohio college janitor hid in ceiling above locker room to photograph women’s soccer team, police say
summary: A janitor at Wilmington College in Ohio was arrested Tuesday for hiding in the ceiling above a locker room to photograph the women’s soccer team as they changed, police said.
story: A janitor at Wilmington College in Ohio was arrested Tuesday for hiding in the ceiling above a locker room to photograph the women’s soccer team as they changed, police said.
Jayson Barker was charged with 11 counts of voyeurism after a member of the team spotted the alleged offender snapping photos from above in a locker room at the Scheve Athletic Center.
Barker was detained by campus security until police arrived.
He was held on $22,000 bail at a nearby jail after his arrest but has since been released after posting it, according to the police and jail officials.
Wilmington College said in a statement that Barker worked for a vendor and that the school’s relationship with the custodial services contractor has since been terminated.

“The College’s paramount concern is the safety and well-being of its students,” Wilmington College said in a statement. “We have been providing counseling and other support services for the affected students since Tuesday night and are taking measures to ensure that no student’s safety or well-being is compromised.”
Investigators are trying to determine whether Barker has a history of similar conduct. He could face additional charges. Barker is next due in court on Oct. 5.

title: San Francisco Giants’ ‘mom of the year’ defends husband after clip sparks online backlash
summary: A woman Giants announcers dubbed “mom of the year” after cameras caught her carrying a baby and an armful of food back to her seat while a man beside her began eating is saying the viral clip didn’t show the whole story.
story: A woman Giants announcers dubbed “mom of the year” after cameras caught her carrying a baby and an armful of food back to her seat while a man beside her began eating is saying the viral clip didn’t show the whole story.
“Before you decide what our marriage looks like, I would like you to hear from the woman you’re defending,” she wrote.

The woman, who identified herself as Erika, described what happened at Tuesday’s San Francisco Giants game in a Substack post Friday. She said she had taken their daughter to the restroom and offered to pick up food for her husband, Ramses, on the way back. He told her to get him whatever had the shortest line.

When she returned, Ramses asked whether she wanted to eat first, Erika wrote. She told him to go ahead because she had eaten before the game and knew he had not had a full meal that day. He also offered to take the food containers off her lap and share his sandwich, but she declined.

Giants announcers Mike Krukow and Duane Kuiper narrated the scene as the camera lingered on the family. They dubbed Erika “mom of the year” and jokingly imagined that Ramses had asked her for ketchup and that she wanted to smack him. Erika said neither exchange happened.
“I understand how it looked on television,” she wrote. “But we could hear each other. The announcers and audience couldn’t.”

The was another reason Erika wanted Ramses to enjoy the game, she said. He had recently lost a childhood friend who was a gifted baseball player, and she had suggested the outing as a way for her husband to remember him.
“The camera showed what I was carrying in my hands,” she wrote. “It couldn’t show what he was carrying that night.”

Erika said she and Ramses initially laughed at the broadcast. But as the clip spread online, strangers began criticizing him and making assumptions about their marriage. Some found the couple’s names and phone numbers, she wrote, and some sent Ramses messages telling him to kill himself.
Erika said she believed that the announcers and Giants production team meant no harm. But she told them their jokes helped turn her husband into a source of ridicule.
“What was a few moments of amusement on your broadcast became days of real pain for our family,” she wrote.
A Giants spokesperson did not return a request for comment.
Erika said she appreciated being called “mom of the year” but asked people to listen when she described her own life.
“You can appreciate what I was doing that night without assuming I have to do everything alone,” she wrote. “Supporting me also means listening when I tell you about my own life.”

title: Bomb squad searching vans near U.S. air base in Britain after five men arrested
summary: LONDON — British police arrested several men on suspicion of terror and explosives offenses on Sunday and evacuated homes near an air base that the U.S.
story: LONDON — British police arrested several men on suspicion of terror and explosives offenses on Sunday and evacuated homes near an air base that the U.S. Air Force had been using to facilitate strikes on Iran.
A major incident was declared, with a massive emergency presence seen around RAF Fairford, which is about 90 minutes outside London, close to the village of Whelford in west England.

The Gloucestershire police force said it responded in the early hours of Sunday to reports of three suspicious vehicles moving toward the base, and arrested five men “on suspicion of committing offenses under the Explosives Act.” They were later further arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.

Police did not provide further details on the men, who remain in custody, or what they were suspected to have done. “Work to establish the full nature of this incident is ongoing,” a police spokesperson said.
The force said 85 homes across the local area were evacuated and a 440-yard cordon put in place while an Army ordnance disposal team examines the vehicles.
Helicopter footage from Sky News showed multiple white vans close to the base seemingly being searched by a bomb disposal robot.

Julian Tudsbery, who has lived in Whelford for 30 years, told Britain’s Press Association another resident had reported three suspicious vans in the village. Along with other residents, Tudsbery has since been evacuated to a nearby recreation center.

The Reuters news agency had reported that security measures at the air ‌base have been significantly increased in recent ‌days. A spokesperson for the U.S. ‌Air Force told the agency they would not discuss specific force protection measures.

“The 501st Combat Support Wing and our fellow ⁠UK-based Wings remain vigilant and ⁠will take appropriate actions to ensure the safety and security ‌of our US service members, civilians, contractors, and their families,” the spokesperson ‌said, ahead of the police statement.
“We constantly assess ⁠a variety of factors that determine what measures we institute or modify to protect our installations, our people and their families,” they added.
The British government said Prime Minister Andy Burnham is being updated about the incident, adding “it would be inappropriate to comment further whilst investigations are ongoing.”
In March this year, Burnham’s predecessor Keir Starmer gave permission for the U.S. to use its bases for “specific and limited defensive” operations against Iran.

In July, Iran’s ⁠Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned Britain that “any base used to invade Iranian territory is our legitimate target,” Iran’s semiofficial Tasnim news agency reported, citing bomber aircraft flights from Fairford.
At the time, a British government spokesperson said that the country was “ready to keep the United Kingdom safe from any kind of attacks, whether it’s on our soil or from abroad.”

Roz Savage, the local member of Parliament, thanked police for their response to “worrying scenes just outside the RAF Fairford base,” while British Defense Secretary Wes Streeting said in a post on X: “We can be reassured that this is being dealt with and it is exactly why our emergency response teams and Armed Forces are on standby 24/7.”

title: What Time Do the 2026 VMAs Start? How to Watch Tonight’s Awards Show
summary: When do the 2026 VMAs start? What is the start time of the 2026 VMAs? Here’s how to watch the awards show.
story: It’s that time of year again for music’s biggest stars to take the stage for the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards.

The annual award show returns this Sunday, Sept. 27, and will highlight some of the biggest artists, songs and performances voted on by fans over the last year. Snoop Dogg is hosting this year’s festivities in Los Angeles for the first time, other notable award presenters such as Teyana Taylor and Charli xcx.

Madonna leads this year’s nominations with 11 nods, followed by Taylor Swift with nine and Sabrina Carpenter and Ariana Grande with seven each. The VMAs will also welcome 26 first-time nominees to the show this year, including Olivia Dean, Noah Kahan and Yung Lean.

In addition to awards, the night will also feature a star-studded lineup of performances. Among those taking the stage are Madonna, kicking off the night, and Sienna Spiro, Lisa and Shaboozey, to name a few.

This year’s ceremony will honor two music legends with special tribute performances. Kacey Musgraves will pay tribute to late country singer Dolly Parton, while RAYE, Sombr and Teddy Swims will honor artist George Michael.

Whether you’re tuning in for the performances, hoping to see your favorite artist take home an award, or simply need a glimpse at this year’s fashion choices, here’s everything you need to know about how to watch the 2026 VMAs.
When Are the 2026 VMAs?
The 2026 VMAs will take place on Sunday, Sept. 27.
What Time Are the 2026 VMAs?
The VMAs will begin at 7:30 p.m. ET/4:30 p.m. PT. This year’s show is scheduled to run about two hours.
How to Watch the 2026 VMAs
The VMAs will be broadcast live Sunday night on MTV and CBS, with live streaming available on Paramount+ with a subscription to the Paramount+ Premium plan.
How to Vote for the 2026 VMAs
Viewers over the age of 13 can cast votes for their favorites by visiting MTV’s official voting site. Each person is allowed up to 10 votes each day per category.
Voting for most categories closed Friday, Sept. 25, with the exception of best new artist, which ends on the day of the VMAs, Sunday, Sept. 27.

title: Khloé Kardashian Is Ready to Find Her ‘Forever Person’ and Grow Her Family
summary: Khloé Kardashian tells TODAY.com she is open to dating, expanding her family and shares the biggest lesson age has taught her.
story: For almost two decades, Khloé Kardashian has let viewers witness some of the most intimate and joyous moments of her life.

The entrepreneur and reality star was only 23 years old when the first season of “Keeping Up With the Kardashians” premiered in 2007. The show ended in 2021 after 20 seasons, but she and her famous family continue to document their lives on “The Kardashians.”
Now, at the age of 42, Kardashian is looking for her “forever person,” would love to expand her family and knows that age and time gives you the best lessons in life.
Among the most important one she’s learned is being present and in the moment, “That’s probably my biggest one,” Kardashian tells TODAY.com.
Another major lesson that came with age is believing in herself and giving the same supportive energy to her needs as she gives to others.

“It’s so funny how when you’re young and everyone’s like, ‘Oh, the older you get you really just don’t care what people think.’ And I’m not saying I don’t care what anyone thinks, I do. But the pool is getting smaller of people that I care about what they think of me,” she explains.
For example, starting her “Khloé in Wonder Land” podcast in 2025 was a major risk she took after struggling with self confidence in her mid-30s.

Kardashian says she used to feel “so confident, so secure” prior to that time in her life. “I would try any new business venture. If it failed, I was like, ‘Who cares? Everyone fails at things. Great learning lesson. Let’s move on.’”

“Then I got to a point I wouldn’t try anything because I got so in my head. Just, ‘Failure is bad, and everyone’s going to look at me a certain way.’ And I just felt so judged by so many people. I really let that get to me,” she recalls. “I would be rooting for everyone else and say such positive things to everyone. And then finally, I was like, ‘Why don’t I give myself the same energy I’m giving everybody else?’”
So what changed? Going to therapy, she says, changed her perspective.

“I’m like, ‘OK, what if it doesn’t do well? What does that mean?’ That means, ‘OK, it didn’t do well. Let’s pivot, do something else,’ and that does come with age,” she says. “That came with also working on myself. But a lot of it was like, you know what? Who cares? I’m growing up. I want to be more secure with myself. I want to show my kids that you should try new things.”
Since entering her 40s, Kardashian says she feels “really free and good within myself.”
“I feel really powerful, and I missed that because I had that for so many years and for about a decade, maybe a little less, I really lost that,” she says, “I’m proud that I was able to get it back.”
That confidence has translated to more business ventures, comfortable in her own skin and ready to put herself out in the dating world.
Season 8 of “The Kardashians” premieres Oct. 8. The trailer released mid-September teases Kardashian saying she’s single, ready to mingle and wanting more children.
“Oh my gosh, my daughter (True) asked me today about more kids, about a sister. I’m like, Oh my gosh!,” she says, adding that her children are “begging for it.”
“I’m like, I don’t know what I’m going to do. But I love kids, so I definitely need to figure out my life.”
Life is busy for Kardashian, who says she’s “definitely single” but open to meeting someone special.
“I want to put myself out there. I do want to find a forever person. I also want to just date and not have pressure on that,” she explains, adding that she just wants to have fun.
“That’s what I want first to ease myself into it. I just don’t even know how you do that in today’s day and age,” Kardashian says with a laugh. “I need help. It’s tough, right?”

Kardashian was previously married to Lamar Odom and shares daughter True, 8, and son Tatum, 4, with ex-boyfriend Tristan Thompson. Over the years she’s expressed that she’s not looking to date ... until now.
“I don’t know how to help myself, so I think that’s my biggest challenge,” she says. “But anyone reading this, I’ll take tips and advice.”

title: Backstreet Boys Re-Create Iconic ‘Millennium Tour’ Surfboard Entrance— And Fans Are Not OK
summary: The Backstreet Boys re-created their “Into the Millennium” entrance, riding futuristic surfboards as they opened their first show for their German residency.
story: Check on your friends who are Backstreet Boys fans, they might be unwell.
The group kicked off their “Into The Millennium HOMECOMING: Live in Germany” shows on Friday, Sept. 25 and made an unforgettable entrance that is making fans nostalgic.

In video shared on their Instagram, dramatic music plays as the five singers — Kevin Richardson, AJ McLean, Nick Carter, Howie Dorough and Brian Littrell  — are dressed in black-and-blue ensembles and ascending from the sky on surfboards.
“…but were you ready??” they captioned the video.
After seeing the video of their surfboard entrances fans freaked out online.
“LOSING MY FREAKING MIND I CANNOT HANDLE THIS GET ME TO GERMANY NOOOOOOW!!!!! I am shaking typing this!!!!!!THE SURFBOARDS!!!!! I’m NAUSEOUS!!!! OMGGGG,” one person wrote.
“Oh d---, are you serious? 😱😱😱😱 No, I wasn’t prepared for this. That’s so awesome—you guys are just amazing,” another added.
“Omg I would have DIED,” “Screaming crying throwing up!” and “I. CANT. BREATHE” are among other strong reactions from fans.

Longtime BSB fans recall this epic entrance from their 1999 “Into the Millennium Tour.” Back then, they flew in on futuristic surfboards also while wearing coordinated looks that consisted of royal blue strapped vests, checkered long sleeves and navy pants.
As they made their way to the stage, they opened with “Larger Than Life.”

“There was a couple of flubs that happened on the ‘Millennium’ tour when we used to fly up to the crowd. Kevin got stuck up there one night,” McLean told TODAY.com in 2025 when first announcing their Sphere residency shows in Las Vegas.
Richardson added that he “got stuck up there for, like, three songs.”
This time around, all appeared to go well during the 2026 rendition of the memorable opening.
The Backstreet Boys are performing a number of shows during their first German residency at Merkur Spiel-Arena Düsseldorf.
They previously shared that the location is special as it’s the first country “that ever embraced the Backstreet Boys.”
“You saw who we were before the rest of the world even knew we existed. For this, we are forever grateful, and after 30 years, we are finally coming home,” they wrote on social media.
These concerts come after their highly successful “Into the Millennium” Sphere residency in Las Vegas that was announced on TODAY in February of 2025.
The show is a nod to their 1999 third studio album, “Millennium,” that includes hits “I Want It That Way,” “Larger Than Life” and “Show Me the Meaning of Being Lonely.”
What was meant to be a series of summer shows in 2025 has since continued, with more Sphere shows expected at the end of this year.

title: A Brief History of Madonna and the VMAs: ‘The House She Helped Build’
summary: Madonna is returning to the VMAs. What is Madonna’s history with the VMAs?
story: “Catch Me Up” is a TODAY series where our experts and journalists bring readers up to speed on the day’s biggest headlines.
Where would the MTV Video Music Awards be without Madonna?

Madonna’s name is practically synonymous with the VMAs. She was there from the beginning, rolling around the stage in a wedding dress while performing “Like A Virgin” during the awards show’s 1984 debut.

Over the next four decades, Madonna returned to the VMAs to deliver groundbreaking performances. She’s also made headlines with outrageous antics — like French kissing Britney Spears onstage — and touched fans’ hearts with an emotional tribute to Michael Jackson after the musician’s death in 2009.
Now, the Queen of Pop is poised make a historic return to the 2026 VMAs on Sept. 27 when she performs at the awards show for the first time in 23 years.
Madonna’s performance will kick off the awards show for a record-breaking fifth time, ending her tie with Rihanna, who’s opened the show four times.
Madonna who released her hit album, “Confessions II,” in July, also goes into this year’s VMAs as the most nominated performer.
The singer is “returning to sit on her throne for the night,” NBC News entertainment contributor Chris Witherspoon tells TODAY.com.

“You simply cannot tell the story of the VMAs without telling the story of Madonna. From ‘Like a Virgin’ in 1984, to ‘Vogue’ in 1990, to that unforgettable 2003 performance with Britney Spears, Christina Aguilera and Missy Elliott, Madonna understood the assignment before we even had the phrase,” said Witherspoon.
“Madonna returning to the VMAs doesn’t feel like a comeback to me. It feels like the Queen of Pop returning to the house she helped build,” Witherspoon added.
Ahead of Madonna’s triumphant VMAs return, let’s take a look back at her 10 biggest moments at the awards show.
1) The Wedding Dress Seen Round the World (1984)

Madonna’s audacious performance at the inaugural MTV Video Music Awards in 1984 — she rolled around the stage in a punky ensemble that includes a wedding dress, rosary beads and a “Boy Toy” belt buckle — became her breakout moment.
The raunchy performance, which also included some bumping and grinding, also branded the VMAs as a rebellious alternative to the Grammys and other awards shows.

“MTV could barely fill the seats at the VMAs in year one. By year two, pretty much every act wanted a spot on that stage. Madonna was at the first show in 1984, rolling across the stage in a wedding dress singing ‘Like a Virgin.’ I’d give her a lot of credit for that turnaround,” Jeff Moore, a music marketing strategist, professor, and former touring musician, told TODAY.com.
2) Madonna Expresses Herself (1989)
Madonna returned to the VMAs five years later to deliver one of her finest televised performances when she sang “Express Yourself” with her two backup singers-dancers.

The newly divorced singer — her marriage to Sean Penn officially ended earlier in the year —  began her high-energy, tightly choreographed performance wearing a dark suit before stripping down to a corset.
3) ‘Vogue’ Meets the French Revolution (1990)

The former Material Girl’s breathtaking 1990 performance of “Vogue” was inspired by the French Revolution. Madge as Marie Antoinette? Oh, it worked, right down to her and her dancers’ 18th century-style powdered wigs, heavy white face makeup and corseted gowns.
4) ‘Ray of Light’ with Lenny Kravtiz (1998)
In what’s considered one of the best live performances, Madonna showed off her vocal chops on the soaring “Ray of Light’ with guest guitarist Lenny Kravitz during the 1998 show.
The singer, who kicked off the performance with the Hindu-inspired  “Shanti Ashtangi,” also swept the awards that night, taking home five Moon Man trophies.
5) Madonna Meets Her Drag Impersonators (1999)
The singer was feted the following year by a group of drag queens who wore some of her most memorable looks as they lip-synched and danced to her greatest hits.
“All I have to say is that it takes a real man to fill my shoes!” the singer quipped afterwards.
6) Kissing Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera (2003)
In 2003, Madonna shocked viewers when she took a moment during a throwback performance of “Like A Virgin” to kiss shared her guest performers Britney Spears and Christina Aguilera.
Spears and Aguilera donned skimpy wedding dress looks in a fun nod to Madonna’s debut VMAs performance.
7) An Emotional Tribute to Michael Jackson (2009)

Madonna showed off her serious side when she paid an emotional tribute to her late fellow pop icon Michael Jackson at the 2009 VMAs, calling Jackson “one of the greatest talents the world has ever known.”

“His music,” she said in her speech, “had an extra layer of inexplicable magic that didn’t just make you want to dance but actually made you believe you could fly, dare to dream, be anything that you wanted to be.”
She also recalled going to dinner with Jackson years before.

“Later we went back to my house to watch a movie and sat on the couch like two kids, and somewhere in the middle of the movie, his hand snuck over and held mine,” she said. “It felt like he was looking for more of a friend than a romance, and I was happy to oblige. In that moment, he didn’t feel like a superstar. He felt like a human being.”
8) A Surprise Appearance, Motherf-----! (2021)
Decked out out black dominatrix bodysuit and cap, Madonna made a surprise appearance to open the 2021 VMAs.
The singer’s appearance came just after viewers watched a short video telling the story of her arrival in New York City decades before with just $35 to her name.
Madonna then walked out onstage, telling the crowd, “And they said we wouldn’t last. But we’re still here, motherf------!”

title: Taylor Swift’s ‘Babylon,’ Explained by 2 History Professors
summary: Taylor Swift’s new song “Babylon” is about a failed relationship and references a famous city of Mesopotamia. Here’s what to know.
story: Taylor Swift’s new song “Babylon” brings a big historical symbol to describe the arc of one relationship that ends before a person realizes how good it was.
It’s part of four new songs Swift dropped as part of her “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore” album on Sept. 25.

“Babylon” is told in the second person, with Swift singing to directly to “you.” That “you” is described as a man who left home — a “small town,” to be specific. He’s said to be an ambitious “libertine” who later “longs for home.”

When he meets a girl who loves him, it “stopped you cold.” He kept her at arm’s length, though, and kept things “never official.” But in a flash forward during the bridge, Swift sings that “you” seemingly went on to start a family, but he misses the most important parts. She sings about a vignette of a woman hanging Christmas lights with the subject of the song’s son and later calling her mom to say, “It’s not working/ It’s just not worth it if we’re not what he wants.”
That all culminates in an explanation of the song’s chorus, which describes the subject on a train with his “headphones gone,” realizing the song he thought he hated, he actually loves.
“Then that melody is all you want/ You never knew that it was Babylon/ ‘Til it was gone,” Swift sings.

Taken alone, the song implies that Babylon is an idyllic setting, set in the past and something to perpetually long for. But the reference has a storied history. The city is referenced in more than a few pop songs, including a 1998 hit by David Gray and a 2020 song by Lady Gaga.

Wait, What is Babylon?
Babylon was an ancient city located in the middle of what is now Iraq, between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

Amanda Podany, a professsor emeritus of history at California State Polytechnic University, tells TODAY.com Babylon is associated with the idea of ruin. Alexander the Great, as legend has it, razed the city, though Podany says that might not have been the case. Still, the legend persisted.

“There’s plenty of evidence for Babylon continuing to be an important place for hundreds of years after that. But again, that sort of went into the popular consciousness as a metaphor for ruin, as a metaphor for something glorious that that fell,” she says.
Its place in pop culture was potentially solidified in the Bible.

“In the Bible, Babylon gets really bad press,” Lloyd Llewellyn-Jones, professor at the University of Cardiff, tells TODAY.com. “It is the ultimate City of Sin; Babylon is the Mother of Harlots; it is home to the Whore of Babylon, whose reign will usher in Armageddon and bring about the Apocalypse.”
But he says the city was actually one of the most sophisticated in the ancient world.

“It was the first ever metropolis, with an enormous multi-cultural population. It was the centre of arts, literature, culture, and industry. It was New York, Paris, Bangkok, Los Angeles and London rolled into one. There was no city on earth to rival it. Babylon was the Mother of All Cities,” he says.
But Podany doesn’t think the Babylon in this song is associated with sinfulness or ruin.

“She seems to be using it as a stand-in for that place that you didn’t realize was the best until you left it or lost it. So she’s choosing, I think, to not view Babylon as representing its kings (some of whom were, yes, imperialistic and brutal), or its supposed wickedness; she’s looking past all the layers of misunderstanding that have accumulated on the word Babylon,” she said.

In a twist Podany called interesting (and perhaps not intentional), she’s associating Babylon with nostalgia, “in the way ancient Babylonians would have indeed felt about the place 3,000 or 4,000 years ago, perhaps when they were traveling far away.”
She continued, “Babylon would have been remembered as a beloved home.”

title: Why Is Marvel’s ‘Avengers: Endgame’ Being Re-Released With Extra Minutes Of Footage?
summary: What happens in the new footage from Avengers: Endgame? Why is it being re-released? Find out why and what happens.
story: It’s been more than seven years since Marvel’s “Avengers: Endgame” debuted in theaters and (Hulk-) smashed box office numbers, becoming one of the top grossing films of all time.
Now, the film is slated to hit theaters once again on Sept. 25.  This time around, it’s got an estimated four minutes added to the original runtime.

The movie —which united the MCU’s original Avengers Iron Man, Captain America, Hulk, Thor, Black Widow and Hawkeye against supervillain warlord Thanos — marked the conclusion of the first decade of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
So why is it back on the big screen with a smidge of extra footage?
The film’s directors, Anthony and Joe Russo, have described the re-release as “required viewing,” setting up viewers for the future of the “Avengers” franchise.
When and Where Is ‘Avengers Endgame: Encore’ Being Released?
The film — which stars Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson, Mark Ruffalo and several other big names —  will hit theaters once again on Friday, Sept. 25 under the name “Avengers Endgame: Encore.”

Much like when it was first released, the movie will be offered on standard laser projection and IMAX. It will also be shown on Infinity Vision, a Disney-specific certification badge for premium large format theaters.

Those who catch the movie on IMAX and Infinity Vision will be able to watch an additional sneak peek of the much-awaited next film in the “Avengers” franchise, “Avengers: Doomsday,” which comes out on Dec. 18.
Why Is ‘Avengers Endgame’ Being Re-Released?
The Russo brothers, who directed “Endgame,” have said that this re-released version is necessary to watch ahead of “Doomsday,” of which they are also at the helm.

In an interview with Fandango, Joe Russo explained that the re-release, with its added footage, is the connective tissue that links the previous “Avengers” films to the next chapter — one that will usher in the arrival of new supervillain Doctor Doom, also played by Downey Jr.

“There’s a natural progression from ‘Endgame’ into ‘Doomsday’ which is also inclusive of all the other stories that have been playing out,” Joe Russo told Fandango during an interview at San Diego Comic-Con in July.
Of course, fans will also be able to relive all the shocking twists packed in “Endgame” as well, Joe Russo added.
Anthony Russo also explained that the extra few minutes are expected to include some pretty pivotal moments.
“If you saw ‘Endgame’ when it was originally released, you couldn’t see this coming,” he told Fandango.
What Makes This Re-Release Necessary For The Upcoming MCU Storylines?
The original release of “Endgame” was followed by the introduction of villain Kang the Conquerer in 2021’s television series “Loki.” And he’s a villain that Marvel has since abandoned.
Kang, played by Jonathan Majors, was a time traveler who discovered the existence of the Multiverse, seeking to conquer and rule over them all.

The villain was once poised to succeed Thanos as the new Big Bad of the MCU, with Marvel diving into multiverse plotlines and even going so far as announcing in 2022 that film “Avengers: The Kang Dynasty.” would be the successor to “Endgame.” At the time, Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige had even told fans that the film would hit theaters in May 2025.

Majors appeared in a number of Marvel productions including “Ant Man and the Wasp: Quantumania.” However, he was dropped by the studio after he was convicted by a New York City jury of misdemeanor assault and harassment in 2023.
Majors sent a letter to Feige following his termination. In a 2025 interview with Variety, Majors told the outlet that his letter to the Marvel Studios chief included his appreciation for the role.

“I loved my time at Marvel, and I still love Kang,” Majors said, later telling the outlet that he is “not upset at all.” “I’m watching them. I see what they’re doing and I’m pulling for them. If they need me, they know where I’m at.”

Meanwhile, the MCU pursued a different villain, bringing back Downey Jr., the beloved actor behind Tony Stark/Iron Man, to fulfill the role of Doctor Doom. Feige has said that the decision to pivot came before Majors’ controversy.

“We had started even before what had happened to the actor happened,” Feige said during a 2025 roundtable interview with press. “We had started to realize that Kang wasn’t big enough, wasn’t Thanos, and that there was only one character that could be that, because he was that in the comics for decades and decades.”

title: Sheinelle Jones Gives Maleah Joi Moon a Birthday Present on TODAY That Leaves Her Speechless
summary: Maleah Joi Moon celebrated her 24th birthday with a special gift from Sheinelle Jones.
story: Maleah Joi Moon celebrated her 24th birthday with a special gift from Sheinelle Jones.

On Sept. 25, Moon appeared on TODAY to talk about her role as Deborah Wayne, the free-spirited child of Dwayne Wayne and Whitley Gilbert, on Netflix’s “A Different World” sequel, which premiered Sept. 24.

Moon recalled how Debbie Allen, who produced and directed most of the original “A Different World” and returned for the reboot, recognized her talent on the stage. Moon won a Tony Award for her role in “Hell’s Kitchen,” the Broadway musical based on the life and music of Alicia Keys.
“She came to see the show in previews. So she hopped on it before the wave and I feel like that’s a trend for her. She just has such a beautiful vision for things that are impactful,” Moon said.
Moon celebrated her birthday on Sept. 23, and during the interview, Sheinelle gave Moon a present: a T-shirt of Allen’s 1992 cover from Jet Magazine.
Sheinelle revealed she originally bought the shirt for herself.
“And then I was like, wait, I need to give it to Maleah,” Sheinelle said.
“I was going to cut it and make it cute, but then I remembered that I was interviewing you and I want you to have it,” Sheinelle added.
Moon, whose eyes filled with tears, buried her face into the shirt.
“She means so much to me,” she said of Allen.
“Talk about standing on someone’s shoulders,” said Sheinelle. “You’re literally on her shoulders.”
“It’s perfect. She’s perfect,” Moon said of Allen as she and Sheinelle shared an embrace.
Moon called Allen “so many young Black women’s icon” and described their meeting backstage at “Hell’s Kitchen.”
“I cried,” Moon said, recalling the moment, which was captured in a photo. “She just has such a presence about her that is so warm and direct and comforting.”
“Little did I know she would become this pivotal person in my life instead of just an inspiration,” Moon added.

title: Jenna Shares How She Discovered Dad George W. Bush Broke Off an Engagement
summary: A poor grade on a third-grade math test led to a startling discovering when Jenna Bush Hager was a child.
story: A poor grade on a third-grade math test led to a startling discovering when Jenna Bush Hager was a child.
Jenna shared the oblique way she discovered her father, former President George W. Bush, had previously been engaged to another woman before calling off the wedding.
During their chat on TODAY Sept. 25, Sheinelle Jones and Jenna discussed if they knew anyone who had canceled a wedding, sparked by Oprah Winfrey’s recent comments about trusting one’s intuition.
“My dad actually called off a wedding,” Jenna said. “My dad was engaged, and he called off his wedding. They were really young.”
Jenna had no idea until she earned a bad score on a math test in third grade. When her dad was upset with her, she fired back that he probably did the same thing as a kid.

“He was like, ‘No, I didn’t.’ He took out his memory box that my grandmother had made him, or like kind of a photo album, to show a report card, and I saw a wedding announcement to somebody that wasn’t my mom,” Jenna said.
“I started crying and made it about myself, as a third-grader does,” she added.

Bush got engaged in 1967 to Cathryn Lee Wolfman, a fellow college student at the time. The two were both juniors, Bush at Yale and Wolfman at Rice, according to the Houston Press. An announcement of their engagement ran in the Houston Chronicle on Jan. 1, 1967.
Bush ultimately married Jenna’s mother, former first lady Laura Bush, in 1977. The two are parents to Jenna and her twin sister, Barbara.
“I didn’t realize in that third-grade sort of melodramatic (way), good thing he called it off or we wouldn’t have been here,” Jenna said.
The discussion originated from a clip of Winfrey advising people not to ignore their intuition, posing the example of people going through with a wedding when they know they shouldn’t.
Jenna said she once attended a wedding and could sense her friend reluctantly going through with it. The couple ultimately got divorced years later.
“To be able to able to walk away from something like that, you really do have to listen to yourself,” Jenna said.

title: Brandi Carlile Revisits Her Post About First Time Meeting Dolly Parton — Exactly 10 Years Ago on 9/25
summary: Brandi Carlile recalls meeting Dolly Parton for the first time in 2016 and posting about it on social media on Sept. 25, now Dolly Parton Day, 10 years later.
story: As the country gears up to celebrate Dolly Parton Day on Sept. 25 — aka 9/25, in honor of her classic song “9 to 5” — Brandi Carlile is remembering the first time she met the iconic singer, who died last month at the age of 80.

During a Sept. 25 appearance on TODAY, Carlile was reminded of a Facebook post she shared exactly 10 years ago to the day. On Sept. 25, 2016, she posted a photo with Parton and wrote about meeting the “Jolene” singer.
“Well it finally happened... I met the queen! I have no recollection of what I said but @dollyparton is the greatest preacher the world has seen!” Carlile captioned the photo of them.
“I didn’t know that,” Carlile said when told on TODAY the post was from exactly a decade earlier.
“That was backstage at her concert. I went, bought a ticket, went and saw that show,” she added.
The 11-time Grammy winner would go on to forge a relationship with Parton, explaining she had always longed to meet her.
“It’s like every little girl’s dream that ever plays a guitar and sings a song to grow up and find a way to meet Dolly Parton, so I was pretty on mission early on to meet Dolly,” she said.
The two would eventually work together at a music festival in Newport, Rhode Island, in 2019, an experience that Carlile said was made all the better by Parton.
“I got tasked with, or the gift rather, of getting to curate the first all-female headlining set at the Newport Folk Festival, which is just like a history making place,” she said.

“It’s one of the most important festivals I think in in U.S. history, and I just knew we couldn’t do it without Dolly, and so that’s how I became I think close with Dolly, was through her deciding to come and grace the stage of that festival,” she added.
The “Party of One” singer recalled Parton had a very commanding presence.
“She was like half humor. She was formidable, and she was faithful,” she said.
She said Parton arrived at the festival with five-inch heels and fingernails.
“I was so taken aback when I saw that vision of her, and I realized the gravity of the situation, and my eyes started welling up with tears, despite myself, in the dressing room,” Carlile recalled.

“And I just said, ‘I’m really nervous.’ And we were her backing band, and I was like, ‘I feel maybe I’ve bitten off more than I can chew.’ And she says, ‘Well, darling, we need to do something about that,’ and just took my face in her hands and prayed with me, and it was like transformative,” she added.

Carlile credited Parton’s ability to connect with people with her upbringing. Parton was born in Locust Ridge in rural Tennessee. One of 12 children, she was raised in a one-room cabin on the banks of the Little Pigeon River.

“I think it has a lot to do with her growing up poor, and her role in her family, and knowing how to take care of people, but knowing how to lighten the mood, and her faith that permeated everything that she did,” Carlile said.
New York City, New Orleans and Portland, Oregon are among the cities celebrating Dolly Parton Day, but the honors for the beloved singer don’t stop with one day.

Nashville’s airport authority board unanimously voted earlier this month to begin the process to rename the airport after her. Her estate also announced a two-day festival called Dollyfest set for 2027 as a tribute to her.

Drivers in Ohio can also purchase a license plate with Parton’s image to support Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library in the state, while American Airlines will change its daily flight from Dallas to Nashville to flight 925. Aer Lingus is also modifying its flight from Dublin to Nashville to make it flight 95.

title: ‘America’s Got Talent’ Winner Nene Royal Says She ‘Never Expected to Actually Win’
summary: Nene Royal speaks about winning America’s Got Talent and what’s next for her in an interview with TODAY.com.
story: Nene Royal is on her way to being rock royalty.

The 16-year-old singer and guitarist from Thailand won the 21st season of “America’s Got Talent” on Sept. 23, capping a season in which she wowed viewers and the judges with her blistering guitar play and fierce vocals.
After host Terry Crews revealed her name as the winner, Royal fell onto the stage in disbelief.
“I was so shocked because the moment just went completely black,” she told TODAY.com the day after the win.
“There’s so, so many emotions that at once, shock or happiness, everything, and my body just reacted before my brain did,” she added.
Royal already has her eyes on what looks like a bright future.

“My next thing for me is doing some my own songs, or making (an) album, and also making some tours,” she said while noting she’d like to collaborate with acts who’ve influenced and inspired her, including Avenged Sevenfold, Metallica, Limp Bizkit, The Warning and Linkin Park, with whom she performed during the finale.

Royal, who defeated magician Geno Ploege when they were down to the final two acts, says she never felt confident she would win. She earned the Golden Buzzer to advance to the finals after she performed Soundgarden’s “Black Hole Sun,” which told her maybe she did indeed have the chops to win it all.

“I just focused on each round and tried to make every performance better than the last time,” she said. “Maybe after the Golden Buzzer, I started thinking like, ‘Wow, maybe I really do have a chance,’ but I still never expected to actually win.”
Royal also points to the nurturing nature of judges Howie Mandel, Sofia Vergara, Mel B and Simon Cowell, who were kind to her when the cameras weren’t rolling during the competition.
“(They) just came to me and said like, ‘I’m very proud of you and just be yourself and you know your life is going to be changed,’” she said.
Royal, who started playing guitar at age 7, says rock music has proven to be a natural fit for her.

“I think it is the energy, that freedom (of) rock music. When I play rock, especially on guitar, because I feel like I can really be myself and express everything that I’m feeling, because I love the powerful sounds and the guitar solos and the energy that you get from performing it live,” she said.
“And the first time I really got into rock, I was like, ‘Yeah, this is me. This is why I wanted to play.’”
It’s a long way from Thailand for Royal, who grasps the magnitude of her accomplishment winning “AGT,” while also feeling gratitude for the support of her loved ones.

“It’s been such a crazy journey, let’s say that, for all of us, especially coming all the way from Thailand to America. I’m really grateful, and they’ve been there with me through everything,” she said.

title: Taylor Swift’s ‘Pink Clouding’ Is About an Overdue Apology. Read the Lyrics
summary: What is the meaning of Taylor Swift’s new song Pink Clouding on The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore? Read the lyrics.
story: Taylor Swift is offering up an apology in her new track “Pink Clouding.”
The song is one of four new songs on the pop icon’s recently announced “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” out now.

“Pink Clouding” is seemingly about the song’s narrator taking ownership of the ways she let someone else down. She admits it from the first verse. The two met in an idyllic setting. Shades of the color pink are used to show just how idyllic — magenta, fuchsia and rosewood.
Then, Swift drops the bomb, shattering the rose-colored vista: “I was a liar,” though, “neither of us knew it at the time.”
The song describes a case of one person leading the person on while they’re both in a rose-colored dreamscape. Swift says it felt good, “letting you want me ... to make promises.”
Part of the problem was what came before her relationship with this man. Swift says they met at a “cursed time” for her when she was coming off a bad relationship.
“He cut me crimson, bled me dry/ He crossеd my heart, I hoped to die/ ripped all my orchids from the vine,” she sings.
Swift “said I was fine,” but likely wasn’t. The bridge is a straight-up apology.
“And the way I treated you, you never deserved it/ And I swear to God, to this day/ I wake up scared that I left scars on a good person,” she sings.
“Years later, I still wonder how to tell you sorry,” she continues in the bridge.

In the chorus, she also sings she was “gray rocking when the arrow hit.” Gray rocking is a tactic used to disarm manipulative behavior. Instead of reacting, you shut down. This could be a holdover from her past relationship. (“Patient Zero” is notably about being the first person “infected” by a toxic person.) Or, it could be a way for her to describe not being moved when the “arrow” — as in Cupid’s — hit.
She describes the way the relationship ended, which seems abrupt. She “didn’t wanna let you down,” so she “left you up there on a pink cloud.”
“I hope you landed safely on the ground,” she sings later.
Swift first revealed to fans that new music was coming sooner than expected on Sept. 22 when she announced that her new single “Patient Zero” would be out Sept. 25.
She gave Swifties just one day to process the news before she shared that the single was one of four songs on the extended edition of her 12th album, which was released in October 2025.
She said those songs were “born out of pure gratitude for your exuberance for and celebration of the album we made.”
Along with “Pink Clouding” and “Patient Zero,” the new release also includes “Babylon” and “Cleveland!”

title: Taylor Swift’s ‘Patient Zero’ Is About a Toxic Relationship She ‘Walked Away’ From
summary: What is the meaning of Taylor Swift’s new song “Patient Zero” on “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore?” Read the lyrics.
story: “Patient Zero,” one of Taylor Swift’s four new songs released as part of her “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” opens with an evocative and melancholy violin, setting the tone for the rest of the song.
The song is structured like a one-sided phone call, with Swift’s character speaking to a caller about a man they both knew — and warning her about him.
“I’ve gotta be honest, I’ve been expecting your call,” she sings.

Swift calls herself “patient zero,” meaning the first person infected by the “toxins” from the subject of the song. Because she dated him before the new person, she’s trying to wake the caller up to the truth.
“If you’re sick of him I got you, I was patient zero,” she says.

Swift describes a relationship with all the hallmarks of love bombing: He burst into your life like “fireworks” and says “I love you” first. But, according to the lyrics, he also cheats, parties and gets bored.
Swift speak-sings more details about this man’s sins and how they were at first disguised. Missteps include:

Charm: “I know he charmed your family and friends/ And you thought it’s ‘cause he loves you/ But it’s ‘cause he loves how everybody else loves him”Using his partner for clout: “I know it seems like he shines so bright/ But he’s bathing in your reflected light/ On a free solo social climb”

Using his partner for clout: “I know it seems like he shines so bright/ But he’s bathing in your reflected light/ On a free solo social climb”
Swift says she “said all of this to his face” and eventually “walked away.”
This is a departure from other songs on “The Life of a Showgirl,” which is largely inspired by her happy relationship with her husband Travis Kelce and her experience on “The Eras Tour.”
Swift will release the music video for “Patient Zero” at the VMAs on Sept. 27, where Swift will also be the inaugural recipient of the first-ever Artist Director Honors.

“The Life of a Showgirl” was Swift’s reflection coming out of her career-retrospective “Eras” world tour. Written and produced with Max Martin and Shellback while on the tour, the album explores the highs and lows of fame, and what it means to fall in love with all eyes on you. The upbeat pop record broke first-week sales records, and singles “The Fate of Ophelia” and “Opalite” topped charts.

Swift has characteristically kept herself busy in the last year. She became one of the youngest people inducted in the Songwriters Hall of Fame, released “I Knew It, I Knew You” for Disney’s “Toy Story 5,” and married Travis Kelce in a massive wedding at New York City’s storied Madison Square Garden.

title: Is Taylor Swift’s ‘Cleveland!’ About Who We Think It Is? Lyrics Say Definitely
summary: What is Taylor Swift’s “Cleveland!” about? Read the song lyrics and find out exactly how they are a reference to Travis Kelce.
story: Taylor Swift wants us all to know she’s found the love of her life.
One of four songs released as part of “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” “Cleveland!” proves another saccharine sweet love story overflowing with references to her now husband Travis Kelce.
In classic Swift fashion, he’s never mentioned by name, and she’s famous for rarely confirming the inspiration for her songs. But this song has a pretty clear source.

The song’s narrator consistently sings about feelings of insecurity, both from herself and from the world at large, opening with the sentiment, “She’s not as hot as she was.” But the instrumentals, driven by energetic drums and uplifting piano, keep things light leading into the big twist brought on by the chorus: She only really cares what one person thinks.
“My baby likes what he likes,” she sings.

She sings about how he’s already taken her to Cleveland and shown her “the Heights.” Kelce is from Westlake, Ohio, near Cleveland Heights, which inspired the name of his podcast with brother Jason Kelce, “New Heights.”

This is the second time Swift has referenced “Heights” on a song. The first came on the original “Life of a Showgirl” tracklist, “Wood,” an innuendo pop song with a chorus that includes the line, “New Heights of manhood.”
By the end of the song, she’s singing about more than just visiting someone’s hometown — she’s preparing to walk down the aisle.
“Now I’m wearin’ white, so hate all you like/ This is the love of my life,” she sings to close out the song.
Swift and Kelce married on July 3 at Madison Square Garden after getting engaged in August 2025.

title: Which Accomplice Was Recruited in ‘The Traitors: New Blood’ Episodes 3 and 4?
summary: Find out which accomplice the Traitors recruited and who was murdered or banished in Episodes 3 and 4 of “The Traitors: New Blood.”
story: Warning: Spoilers from “The Traitors: New Blood” Episodes 3 and 4 below.
The all-civilian cast of “The Traitors: New Blood” are not afraid to play a ruthless game.

Following the murder and banishment in the supersized premiere, the Traitors were eager to get more blood on their hands and make big moves. But Episodes 3 and 4 upped the ante by adding elements to the game that could disrupt the Traitors’ plans.

In the newest episodes, which aired Sept. 24 on NBC, Traitors Tomica and Joe officially offered one of their accomplices — Katie and Xavier — the opportunity to join them in the turret, meaning the other one was murdered. But the drama didn’t stop there, as two missions caused distrust to spread among the Faithfuls.
The episode ended with a cliffhanger after one of the Traitors was called out at the Round Table, putting their game at risk. Read a recap of all the major moments from Episodes 3 and 4.
The Traitors Recruit and Murder
Episode 3, titled “The Traitors Are Watching,” opened with accomplices Xavier and Katie meeting the Traitors and host Alan Cumming in the front of the castle during the middle of the night.

Joe and Tomica revealed their identities to their two accomplices, who said they didn’t suspect either one of them. Xavier and Katie shared that they both successfully completed their task from the last episode of securing a death warrant. That meant it was up to the Traitors to decide which player to recruit and which one to murder.

The Traitors announced that they wanted to add Katie to their group. After learning his fate, Xavier said in his final confessional, “Your boy is gone and it stings right in the heart. I felt like I was the stronger choice of the two. I was going to come out on top. I’d take this whole thing home.”
Meanwhile, Katie celebrated with Joe and Tomica, giddily telling them, “We are going to do very, very bad things together.”
First Mission

At breakfast the next morning, the players learned Xavier was murdered and they were stunned. Logan remembered that Xavier threw out Katie’s name before he left, so he shared the information with some other players. Meanwhile, Jay was starting to look suspicious after he told a group of players that he wanted to keep his Traitor theories to himself until the right moment.

For the first mission of the night, the players arrived in a field where Alan shared that there was $30,000 up for grabs. During the mission, the players had to use a battering ram to open three crypts that contained varying amounts of gold. But, only some players had the opportunity to enter the crypts. Alan warned, “There may be more than just gold awaiting you when you enter.”

The first two players to go inside were Alisa and Morgan. They found $5,000 and Alisa swiftly exited while Morgan lingered to look for a shield. Next, Tomica and Clyde entered crypt two and were presented with two options: $10,000 or $5,000 and a shield. They opted to give the shield to Clyde and took $5,000.

In the third and final crypt, Michael and Ben were given two options: $15,000 or $5,000 and “top secret Traitor info.” They chose the second option and received a clue that read, “Last night two players battled in plain sight to become a Traitor.”
After the mission, cracks in the group started to form as the Faithfuls questioned why they only added $15,000 to the prize pot if $30,000 was available.
A Banishment at the Round Table
When the players returned to the castle, they started scheming again. Some theorized that Arisa and Victor were Traitors because in the previous episode they held hands while Arisa questioned him.

At the Round Table, Michael revealed his clue.  Niyyah said the clue could point to Arisa since she did her “trust test” with Victor in front of people. But Kriste interjected to suggest that maybe Xavier was competing to be a Traitor and that’s why he was eliminated. That led Jay to bring up Xavier’s warning about Katie, with Logan confirming Xavier’s final words.

Episode 4, titled “The Death Parade,” began with Joe jumping in to defend Katie at the Round Table. Focus then switched back to Victor. Victor tried and failed to get the players to turn on Michael before the vote began. Arisa received the most votes and was banished.
“So, I’ve had a lot of fun playing this game with you guys. And from the beginning I have and always will be Faithful,” she said before exiting.

Logan revealed in his confessional that he was still suspicious of Katie. Elsewhere, Abby L. chatted with Sherry, who was noticeably quiet at the Round Table. Sherry told Abby L. to start watching the men because “we know there’s not three female Traitors.” Abby L. repeated the conversation to a few others, questioning how Sherry knew the exact number of Traitors.
In the turret, the Traitors shared their shortlist for murder: Logan, Abby L. and Mark. Joe suggested that Katie make the final decision as the new Traitor.
A Second Murder
During breakfast, viewers and the players learned that Logan was murdered.

“It finally arrived in the mail,” Logan sarcastically said when he arrived for his confessional interview and saw a letter from the Traitors. “You know something? I said Katie yesterday. I don’t know. Maybe I got close. Maybe I didn’t. I guess we’ll find out. Dang,” he said before departing.
Second Mission

Before the next mission started, Jay informed viewers in his confessional that his chaotic personality and behavior was part of his plan. He said he wanted the Traitors to view him as a distraction so they would keep him around longer.

At the mission, Alan said there was $24,000 available. The players had to push a wagon filled with gold to the end of a path. Along the path, they would encounter three gates that they needed to open before the death parade caught up to them. Any player caught by the parade would be on the shortlist for murder.

When they reached the first gate, the players learned that they had to leave four people behind. Victor, Niyyah, Morgan and Mark volunteered to be captured by the death parade. Kriste and Tomica stayed behind at gate two. The final four players who sacrificed themselves at gate three were Abby L, Joe, Clyde and Sherry.

Throughout the mission, Jay irritated multiple players by refusing to sacrifice himself. He particularly irked Katie who called him out for not contributing. Before returning to the castle, Alan revealed that the players would attend a funeral for one of the eight people left behind.
Back at the castle, Jay apologized to the players. He also pointed out that Katie was too upset with his behavior during the mission, suspecting she is a Traitor.

Going into the Round Table, Katie said in her confessional that she was nervous Jay would come after her. And he did just that. Jay opened the discussion by saying he had been collecting information for four days that confirmed his theory that Katie is a Traitor. The episode ended on a cliffhanger with Katie in the hot seat.
What Will Happen Next Week?

Fans will have to wait to see if Katie can successfully avoid banishment and if her fellow Traitors will speak up to save her. “The Traitors: New Blood” will not air a new episode next week  due to the MLB Wildcard Series.
Episode 5 of “The Traitors: New Blood,” titled “Wake of the Living Dead,” will arrive Thursday, Oct. 8, at 8 p.m. ET/ PT on NBC.

title: ‘AHS’ Season 13 Unites the OGs. Here’s Which Characters Are Returning
summary: “American Horror Story” is returning some of the OG cast members. Here’s who is coming back for Season 13 of American Horror Story.
story: “American Horror Story” is going all out for its 13th season, reuniting cast members and characters that fans have been missing for years.

After taking 2025 off, “AHS” will return with its aptly subtitled “13” season on Sept. 24. The three-episode premiere will arrive on FX and stream on Hulu. Subsequent episodes will be released in batches until the finale, Episode 13, on Oct. 29.

While most seasons of the horror anthology series give away their themes with their subtitles, fans are still speculating what the new season will be about. Co-creator Ryan Murphy has shared few plot details, but he has revealed that many stars who appeared in earlier seasons of “AHS” will be returning to reprise some fan-favorite characters.

Jessica Lange will portray all four of her characters from “Murder House,” “Asylum,” “Coven” and “Freak Show,” Murphy told Vogue, while Evan Peters will play five of his past characters and Sarah Paulson will revisit six of hers.

Murphy explained to the magazine that he wanted “13” to be a return to the origin of the show. “I just thought the number 13 was infused with so much stuff in the horror genre, and I wanted to do a greatest hits season. I didn’t know what it was, but I knew that I could only do it with Jessica,” he said about convincing Lange to return.  (She told Variety that she is playing a mysterious fifth character, too.)
He also confirmed that the season is not just focusing on “Coven” characters, although many of them will appear.

“I was very interested in the greatest villains we’ve done. And I felt that they only would come together if we had a new story anchored by a new person. That person is Joey Pollari,” Murphy revealed.
The trailer also hinted at all the characters coming back. It showed glimpses of new characters, played by actors like Paul Anthony Kelly, as well.
Who is the major villain this season? Murphy didn’t spill. However, he did tease a new big bad.
“But let me just put it this way: In many seasons, the (characters) have battled the Antichrist. The only hint I’ll say is, ‘Let’s go above his pay grade for this.’ That’s my clue,” he shared.
